change: Store rally membership, arrival progress, returning defenders and worker evacuation in the existing per-unit unitClaims table. Persistent task state contains only the hall, fixed post, phase and observed threat/health information.

ownership.mineRally: Accepted rally orders; arrived records actual entry into the gathering radius.
ownership.mineLeash: Accepted return order; resumeKind restores the prior mineRally/mineGuard assignment on return.
ownership.mineGuard: Accepted general defend/guard orders; replaces the leash defenderIds cohort.
ownership.workerSafety: Accepted evacuation orders; origin, shelter and original/safe mine are claim data.
ownership.strategic_redirect: An accepted movement from a script with redirects=strategic (or undeclared) releases the old claim in recordAiMemoryForCommands. Empty/rejected commands do not transfer ownership.
ownership.local_redirect: Local fighting retains its task. Local retreat coordinates remain on that same claim, so existing pullback micro can finish its route.
ownership.lifecycle: Use activeUnitClaim and pruneAiPolicyMemory for expiry, owner and target existence. New task claims use the existing 3600-tick objective window and accepted local movement renews it.
ownership.expansionGarrison: Reader/type support for the expansion branch’s future garrison claim. Rally, leash, local detachments, main-army and mounted-field selectors, and the next expansion preserve this ownership; local micro keeps the same claim. This PR does not assign garrisons.

compatibility: Retain the typed landExpansion.unitIds compatibility read in expansionOwnsDefender until the expansion branch migrates its own state. expansion-mission only changes its defense membership reads to activeUnitClaim; its landExpansion mission storage and workflow remain.

command_equivalence.schedule: both full AI stacks, thinkInterval=15, normal phases and 3-tick delivery delay

behavior_regressions: The 14:48 gathering/early-fight/damage assertions, 19:50 pursuit/physical-return assertions and 32:36 six-worker survival/safe-mining assertions are unchanged. Test setup/accessors now use claims rather than removed lists. The three original fixture files are unedited. Preserve #535’s first-wave-only anchor check and separate second-raid rally assertions; query that second rally’s members by both claim kind and defended hall.

coverage: rejected rally proposals do not acquire units
worker evacuation claims require accepted orders
local vs strategic vs undeclared script transfers
an empty strategic plan does not transfer units
general plan-only change does not erase an actual guard
local pullback keeps task ownership and retreat micro
expiry and hall loss release claims
expansion garrison is not borrowed by defense or next expansion

validation.a100_worker_limitation: Earlier isolated A100 attempts time out after ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for extensionless ./host from node-entry.ts; all four tests pass on juma, including this rebased code. No thread code or timeout was changed.
validation.supplemental: The final second-rally membership check is scoped to its own hall; all 11 rally cases pass again locally.

shared_functions: runScriptsWithContext: pass each script’s redirect semantics to the claim recorder
unitRetreatClaim and focusFireReadyUnit: preserve existing local combat semantics
archerMicro.claimsUnits / v2SkirmishFallbackPoint: read retreat movement from the same claim
miningRallyAssignment / planMiningRally / accepted-command and final-state hooks
miningLeashAssignment / planMiningLeash / recordMiningGeneralCommands / accepted-command and final-state hooks
workerSafetyPlans / planWorkerSafety / accepted-command and release hooks
mineDefense detachment / miningRally and miningLeash wiring / mountedFieldPlans
prepareExpansionMission / expansionMissionCommands: replace removed defense-list reads; expansion mission itself is not migrated
